attacks.attack: The plan is not maintainable because it repeats the same behavior changes across six Astro components.
attacks.defense: Manual repetition is the current local pattern, but it already produced shared bugs; keeping it would preserve the failure mode.
attacks.suggestedFix: Introduce a shared contact-form helper and make design files declarative.

attacks.attack: Production config behavior is underspecified for preview builds and missing sitekey builds.
attacks.defense: Original plan mentioned import.meta.env.PROD but did not specify DEV-only demo success.
attacks.suggestedFix: Gate no-widget demo success only on import.meta.env.DEV; production and preview builds must show fallback email error.

attacks.attack: The server hostname validation could become too permissive or test-driven rather than production-driven.
attacks.defense: The prior hostname line was intentionally cautious but ambiguous.
attacks.suggestedFix: Exact hostname allowlist with env override and no substring/wildcard matching.

attacks.attack: Env rename creates a deploy coordination hazard that the user can forget.
attacks.defense: Code can fail closed, but a forgotten Cloudflare env rename would silently break contact delivery until noticed.
attacks.suggestedFix: Add deployment note to VERIFICATION.md and explicit tests for new env binding.

attacks.attack: Verification step might miss client bundle leakage after the env rename.
attacks.defense: Semgrep and npm audit do not prove bundle secrecy.
attacks.suggestedFix: Add post-build rg checks against dist for old/new key names and access_key.
